answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by bonding collateral to each identity and linking equivocation evidence across identities. If k coordinated identities sign conflicting histories, aggregate penalties grow quadratically, O(k²), rather than linearly; once detected, the swarm incurs an exponential multiplier in capital loss through forfeiture, asymmetric depreciation, and cascading slashes. Thus, control becomes uneconomical from zenith to horizon, while each pearl of evidence improves attribution.
